propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed to monitor advisory criteria for promotion/demotion without outcome-corpus git-walks or per-criterion wiring.

The recorder reads persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and appends firing rows to an append-only ledger, computing detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction later dropped without remediation) over a trailing window.

The recorder must be idempotent (dedup key: ticket+review_ts+round_uuid+norm_id), auto-include every criterion observed, and integrate as a periodic incremental --record followed by --report, distinct from and complementary to R7's outcome-corpus metric.
The implementation must produce deterministic unit tests on synthetic fixtures and committed metrics over the existing sidecar corpus, with zero LLM calls and no hot-path modifications.
